description: A residential real estate purchase contract

form_name.description: The printed title of the contract form, e.g. 'Residential Resale Real Estate Purchase Contract'

form_publisher.description: The organization that drafted the pre-printed form

form_version_date.description: The 'Document updated' date of the form as printed, e.g. 'February 2020'

premises.description: The property being sold, from Section 1b

price_and_payment.description: Purchase price and how it is paid, from Section 1c

full_purchase_price.description: The full purchase price, in dollars

earnest_money.description: The earnest money amount, in dollars

earnest_money_terms.description: The text written beside the earnest money amount

cash_at_closing.description: The amount due in cash at closing, in dollars

earnest_money_form.description: The checked form of earnest money: 'personal check', 'wire transfer' or 'other'

earnest_money_held_by.description: Who holds the earnest money once deposited: 'escrow company' or 'broker trust account'

is_all_cash_sale.description: True if the purchase is paid entirely in cash: earnest money plus cash due at closing equal the full purchase price and no loan amount is listed in Section 1c. False if a loan funds part of the price

close_of_escrow_date.description: The agreed Close of Escrow (COE) date from Section 1d, assembled from its month, day and year blanks, as YYYY-MM-DD

addenda_incorporated.description: Each addendum box checked in Section 1f, as its printed label

escrow.description: The escrow company named in Section 3a

address.description: Escrow company street address, city, state and ZIP

inspection_period_days.description: The Buyer's inspection period in days, from Section 6a. The form prints a default of ten (10) days followed by a blank; when a number is written in the blank, use that number instead of the default

home_warranty_declined.description: True if the box 'Buyer declines the purchase of a Home Warranty Plan' is checked

additional_terms.description: Each additional term written in Section 8a, one per sentence

date.description: The date by which the offer must be accepted, as YYYY-MM-DD

time.description: The time of day, followed by whichever of the 'a.m.' or 'p.m.' boxes is checked [x], e.g. '11:00 a.m.'

seller_broker.description: The broker acting for the seller, from Section 9a

firm_address.description: Firm address, city, state and ZIP

buyer_broker.description: The name printed on the buyer's broker line in Section 8q, or null if blank

is_signed.description: True if the buyer's signature line carries a signature

signed_date.description: The date beside the buyer's signature, as YYYY-MM-DD

name_printed.description: The buyer's name printed below the signature

seller_signature.description: The seller's acceptance signature block, Section 9c

is_signed.description: True if the seller's signature line carries a signature

signed_date.description: The date beside the seller's signature, as YYYY-MM-DD

name_printed.description: The seller's name printed below the signature
